summary: The core production behavior is present and the required validation commands pass, including the open-PR reexecution guard, validate-only/rebase-only recovery paths, remonitor routing, and recovery dispatch events. The implementation does not fully satisfy the saved plan because several planned regression assertions are still missing or too loose in tests.
gaps: Strengthen validate-only recovery tests to assert the no-monitor path ends in completed, the monitor-factory path ends in monitoring_pr, and the recovery completion state_changed event uses reason_code RECOVERY_VALIDATION_OK; current tests allow completed or monitoring_pr and no test asserts RECOVERY_VALIDATION_OK.

Strengthen rebase-only recovery coverage to assert the actual ValidationRun tier is at least 2; current coverage asserts requested_tier on the validate operation but does not directly assert the validation run tier.

Strengthen stale/rebase PR monitor dispatch coverage to assert the monitor.recovery_dispatched event payload and RECOVERY_DISPATCH state event for rebase_only stale recovery, and assert the fake adapter has no calls; current stale dispatch coverage checks terminal status, operation payload, and no merge call but not those planned observability/no-agent assertions.
